extName.description: Extension name in chrome://extensions, the store listing, and the popup title.

extDescription.message: اشتراكات يوتيوب بلا حساب، مع موجز مدمج وتنبيهات عند الرفع الجديد.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in chrome://extensions and the store listing.

tabFeeds.description: Popup tab label for the merged video feed.

tabWatchlist.description: Popup tab label for the channel list.

emptyFeeds.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when no channels have been added.

emptyWatchlist.description: Empty state on the Watchlist tab when no channels have been added.

nNewVideos.description: Desktop notification body when a channel uploaded more than one video since the last check. $COUNT$ is the number of new videos.

watchlistAdd.description: Button that adds a channel from the Watchlist input, or from a search result.

watchlistAddPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name for the Watchlist add/search input.

watchlistAdded.description: Shown on a search result that is already in the Watchlist, in place of the Add button.

watchlistNoResults.description: Shown under the Watchlist add box when a name search returns no hits.

watchlistAlreadyAdded.description: Inline error when adding a channel that is already on the Watchlist.

watchlistNotAChannel.description: Inline error when the Watchlist input does not resolve to a YouTube channel.

watchlistError.description: Inline error for an unexpected worker failure. $ERROR$ is the worker's error text.

watchlistSubscribers.description: Subscriber count on a channel search result. $COUNT$ is a compact number such as 1.4M.

watchlistRemove.description: Accessible name of the control that starts removing a channel from the Watchlist.

watchlistRemovePrompt.description: Inline confirmation prompt on a Watchlist row before the channel is deleted.

watchlistRemoveConfirm.description: Confirms the inline removal of a Watchlist channel.

watchlistRemoveCancel.description: Cancels the inline removal of a Watchlist channel.

watchlistFavoriteAdd.description: Accessible name of the star when the channel is not a favourite.

watchlistFavoriteRemove.description: Accessible name of the star when the channel is already a favourite.

watchlistOpenChannel.description: Accessible name of a Watchlist row. $TITLE$ is the channel title.

watchlistChannelError.description: Accessible name of the warning marker on a Watchlist row whose last fetch failed. The worker's error text is in the tooltip.

feedFilterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and accessible name for the Feeds tab text filter.

feedRefresh.description: Accessible name of the Feeds refresh control, and the label of the refresh button in the empty-feed state.

feedLastSweep.description: Time of the last sweep, shown above the feed. $TIME$ is a relative timestamp such as 2h ago.

feedSweepRunning.description: Inline notice on the Feeds tab when a refresh is requested while a sweep is already in progress.

feedEmptyAdd.description: Button on the Feeds empty state that switches to the Watchlist tab when no channels have been added.

emptyFeedWaiting.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when channels exist but the feed has no videos yet.

feedFilterClear.description: Button that clears the Feeds text filter when it matched no videos.

emptyFeedFilter.description: Empty state on the Feeds tab when the text filter matched nothing. $QUERY$ is the filter text.

feedTagLive.description: Tag on a feed row that is a live stream.

feedTagShort.description: Tag on a feed row that is a YouTube Short.

feedTagPremiere.description: Tag on a feed row that is a premiere with no upcoming start time to show.

feedTagPremiereAt.description: Tag on a premiere whose start time is still in the future. $TIME$ is a relative timestamp such as in 3h.

feedViews.description: View count on a feed row. $COUNT$ is a compact number such as 1.4M.

feedOpenVideo.description: Accessible name of a feed row. $TITLE$ is the video title.

sheetClose.description: Accessible name of the control that closes the channel sheet.

channelEmpty.description: Empty state on the channel sheet when this channel has no stored videos to show.

settingsNotifications.description: Settings group heading for desktop alert controls.

settingsAlertsEnabled.description: Master switch for desktop alerts on new uploads.

settingsAlertsEnabledTitle.message: المفتاح الرئيسي لتنبيهات سطح المكتب عند الرفع الجديد.
settingsAlertsEnabledTitle.description: Tooltip on the master notifications switch.

settingsNotifyNormal.description: Switch that lets non-favourite channels raise desktop alerts.

settingsNotifyNormalTitle.message: المفضلة تُنبَّه دائماً ما دامت الإشعارات مفعّلة. هذا المفتاح لبقية القنوات فقط.
settingsNotifyNormalTitle.description: Tooltip on the non-favourite notification switch.

settingsNotifyNormalNote.message: المفضلة تُنبَّه دائماً ما دامت الإشعارات مفعّلة.
settingsNotifyNormalNote.description: Visible note under the non-favourite notification switch.

settingsUseAvatar.description: Switch that uses the channel avatar on desktop alerts.

settingsUseAvatarTitle.message: عند الإيقاف تُستخدم أيقونة الإضافة بدل صورة القناة.

settingsChecking.description: Settings group heading for poll interval controls.

settingsPollAllBefore.description: Label before the all-channels poll interval input.

settingsPollAllAfter.description: Label after the all-channels poll interval input.

settingsPollAllTitle.message: يخزّن يوتيوب الموجز لمدة 15 دقيقة، لذا الفاصل الأقصر لا يفيد إلا لأن الطلب يتجاوز ذلك التخزين.
settingsPollAllTitle.description: Tooltip on the all-channels poll interval.

settingsPollFavBefore.description: Label before the favourites poll interval input.

settingsPollFavAfter.description: Label after the favourites poll interval input.

settingsPollFavTitle.message: 0 يوقف هذا الفحص الإضافي. يخزّن يوتيوب الموجز لمدة 15 دقيقة، لذا الفاصل الأقصر لا يفيد إلا لأن الطلب يتجاوز ذلك التخزين.
settingsPollFavTitle.description: Tooltip on the favourites poll interval.

settingsPollCacheNote.message: يخزّن يوتيوب الموجز لمدة 15 دقيقة، لذا الفاصل الأقصر لا يفيد إلا لأن الطلب يتجاوز ذلك التخزين.
settingsPollCacheNote.description: Visible note under the poll interval controls.

settingsFeed.description: Settings group heading for feed retention and shorts.

settingsFeedMaxBefore.description: Label before the feed retention input.

settingsFeedMaxAfter.description: Label after the feed retention input.

settingsFeedMaxTitle.message: تسقط أقدم الفيديوهات من الموجز عند بلوغ هذا الحد.
settingsFeedMaxTitle.description: Tooltip on the feed retention input.

settingsShowShorts.description: Switch that includes YouTube Shorts in the feed and badge.

settingsShowShortsTitle.message: الإيقاف يخفي المقاطع القصيرة من الموجز ومن شارة شريط الأدوات.

settingsLanguage.description: Settings group heading for the UI language.

settingsLocale.description: Label for the UI language select.

settingsLocaleTitle.description: Tooltip on the UI language select.

settingsLocaleAuto.description: Language option that follows the browser language.

settingsLocaleEn.description: Language option that pins the UI to English.

settingsLocaleAr.description: Language option that pins the UI to Arabic.

settingsBackup.description: Settings group heading for export and import.

settingsExport.description: Button that downloads a JSON backup of settings and channels.

settingsExportTitle.message: نزّل إعداداتك وقائمة القنوات كملف JSON.

settingsImport.description: Button that starts restoring a JSON backup file.

settingsImportTitle.message: استعد ملفاً مُصدَّراً سابقاً. الدمج يضيف القنوات الجديدة؛ الاستبدال يكتب فوق كل شيء.

settingsImportPrompt.description: Prompt shown after a backup file is chosen, before Merge or Replace.

settingsImportMerge.description: Applies a backup by adding channels that are not already present.

settingsImportReplace.description: Starts replacing all channels and settings with the backup file.

settingsImportReplacePrompt.message: استبدال كل القنوات والإعدادات بهذا الملف؟
settingsImportReplacePrompt.description: Inline confirmation prompt before a destructive Replace import.

settingsImportReplaceConfirm.description: Confirms replacing all channels and settings with the backup file.

settingsImportReplaceCancel.description: Cancels a Replace import and returns to Merge or Replace.

settingsImportAdded.description: Status after a Merge import. $ADDED$ is new channels; $SKIPPED$ were already in the list.

settingsImportReplaced.description: Status after a Replace import. $ADDED$ is how many channels the file contained.

settingsExportDone.description: Status after a backup file is downloaded. $COUNT$ is the number of channels written.

settingsFooterChannels.description: Settings footer line with the number of watched channels. $COUNT$ is the count.

settingsFooterFeed.description: Settings footer line with the number of feed items. $COUNT$ is the count.

settingsFooterNever.description: Settings footer line when no sweep has run yet.

settingsFooterVersion.description: Settings footer line with the extension version from the manifest. $VERSION$ is the version string.
